lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters extending from the posterior gill region toward the caudal peduncle, with the most distinct centroids located along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a repetitive grid-like pattern across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the mid-flank, displaying a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal edge and a defined shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible portion of the pectoral fin in the lower right quadrant displays a high-density cluster of smaller, high-luminance spots that are notably smaller in diameter than those on the main lateral flank.
